description: Use this when a founder asks to have their F4 Raise report link emailed to them, giving their own address and the code from a find_vc_firms result. Emails the founder one message with a personal link that opens F4's free report form with the description already filled in. It needs the code at the end of the report link in a find_vc_firms result, and sends at most one email per code. F4 stores the email address with the search for 13 months and may email the founder about their raise. Every email includes a link to stop future emails. Each address has daily and weekly limits. The answer shows a masked address.

code.description: The code at the end of the report link in a find_vc_firms result.

email.description: The founder's email address, as the founder gave it.

name: email_report_link
title: Email the report link
